meta.title: Why No One Can Survive 45 Minutes In This Room #shorts
meta.description:
Have you ever wanted absolute peace and quiet? Well, there is a place in Minnesota so silent that no one has ever been able to stand it for more than forty-five minutes. It’s called an anechoic chamber, and it absorbs ninety-nine point nine percent of all sound. When you step inside, you don’t just hear nothing—you hear everything inside your own body. Within minutes, the sound of your lungs breathing becomes a roar. You can literally hear the blood pumping through your veins and your stomach digesting. Without any external sounds, your brain starts to panic and create its own noises to fill the void, causing vivid hallucinations. It actually drives people temporarily insane. Could you survive forty-five minutes in this absolute silence, or would you crack? Tell us in the comments and subscribe for more mind-blowing facts!
